title: 第18章 方安第19章 灭口蛊
content_zh:
方正林的尸体被抬走了。
方七带人清理了正堂墙壁上的血迹和人形凹陷，像是什么都没有发生过。但空气中的血腥味还在，淡淡的，若有若无，像一根刺扎在每个人的鼻子里。
方正阳坐在主位上，面前的茶已经换了第三杯，还是一口没喝。他的手搁在扶手上，五指一会儿攥紧，一会儿松开，反反复复。
方圆坐在他旁边的椅子上，闭着眼睛，像是在养神。
王紫璇抱着剑站在门口，目光在正堂内外来回扫视。今晚的事让她意识到，方家的水比她想象的深得多——一个凝气境八重的二长老说死就死了，临死前连幕后主使的名字都没能说出来。
正堂里安静了很久。
最终是方正阳先开了口。
“方圆。”他的声音比平时沙哑，像是砂纸磨过的，“方正林死了，线索断了。接下来怎么办？”
方圆睁开眼睛。
“没有断。”
方正阳眉头一皱：“你知道是谁？”
“不知道。”方圆摇头，“但方正林不是唯一的线索。他只是一个执行者，能接触到的东西有限。真正的主谋，权限比方正林大得多。”
他站起来，走到那堆账本前，翻到其中一页，指着上面的一个名字。
“方安。”
方正阳凑过去一看，眉头皱得更紧了。
方安，方家内务总管，负责方家所有的后勤物资调度。这个职位不显山不露水，但权限极大——灵石、丹药、灵器、药材，所有物资的进出都要经过他的手。
方正林每三个月批一次“报废”灵器出城，但这些灵器从仓库里调出来，经手人是方安。
“方安是方正林的人？”方正阳问。
“方正林只是二长老，方安名义上归他管。”方圆合上账本，“但方安在方家干了三十年，伺候过两任家主。他效忠的不是方正林，而是给钱的人。”
方正阳的眼中闪过一丝寒意。

“我派人去抓他。”
“不用抓。”方圆说，“方安这种人，贪财，怕死。给他足够的压力，他什么都会说。”
“我去。”王紫璇从门口走过来，长剑往桌上一搁，“你们方家的人审方家的人，容易被人说闲话。我一个外人，下手没轻重，谁也说不了什么。”
方正阳看了她一眼，点头：“王小姐，有劳了。”
王紫璇拎着剑出门了。
方七带了几个人跟着她，消失在夜色中。
正堂里又只剩下方正阳和方圆两个人。
方正阳沉默了许久，忽然开口：“方圆，你觉得……方家还有救吗？”
方圆看着他。
这个五十多岁的老人，此刻看起来比任何时候都疲惫。眼角的皱纹深得像刀刻的，鬓角的白发在烛光下格外明显。
“有。”方圆说，“只要家主你在，方家就有救。”
方正阳苦笑了一下：“你倒是会说话。”
“不是会说话，是实话。”方圆重新坐下，拿起那杯已经凉透的茶，一口喝完，“方家的根基不在那些蛀虫身上，在那些愿意为方家拼命的人身上。这种人不多了，但还有。”
他看向方正阳。
“家主你就是其中一个。”
方正阳愣了一瞬，随即笑了起来。
笑声不大，但比之前轻松了许多。
“你比你父亲会说话。”方正阳说，“你父亲那个人，三棍子打不出一个屁来。当年我问他‘你是不是方家最有天赋的人’，他说‘不是’。我问他‘那你觉得是谁’，他说‘不知道’。气得我三天没跟他说话。”
方圆嘴角微微勾起。
“他失踪前最后一个晚上，来找过我。”方正阳的声音低了下来，“他跟我说了一句话——‘大哥，如果我回不来，帮我照顾方圆。’”

方正阳看着方圆，眼眶微微发红。
content_en:
Fang Zhenglin's body was carried away.
Fang Qi led people to clean up the blood stains and dents on the walls of the main hall, as if nothing had happened. But the smell of blood is still in the air, faint and vague, like a thorn piercing everyone's nose.
Fang Zhengyang was sitting in the main seat. The tea in front of him had been changed to a third cup, but he still hadn't taken a sip. His hand rested on the armrest, and his fingers clenched and unclenched for a while, over and over again.
Fangyuan sat on the chair next to him, eyes closed, as if recuperating.
Wang Zixuan stood at the door holding her sword, looking back and forth inside and outside the main hall. What happened tonight made her realize that the water in the Fang family was much deeper than she thought - a second elder who was at the eighth level of the Qi Condensation Realm died as soon as he said he was going to die. Before he died, he couldn't even tell the name of the mastermind behind the scenes.
The main hall was quiet for a long time.
In the end, Fang Zhengyang spoke first.
"Fang Yuan." His voice was hoarse than usual, as if it had been rubbed with sandpaper, "Fang Zhenglin is dead, and the clues are broken. What should we do next?"
Fangyuan opened her eyes.
"It's not broken."
Fang Zhengyang frowned: "Do you know who it is?"
"I don't know." Fang Yuan shook his head, "But Fang Zhenglin is not the only clue. He is just an executor and has limited access to things. The real mastermind has much greater authority than Fang Zhenglin."
He stood up, walked to the pile of ledgers, turned to one of the pages, and pointed to a name on it.
"Fang An."
Fang Zhengyang leaned over and took a look, his brows furrowed even more.
Fang An, the general manager of the Fang family's internal affairs, is responsible for all the logistics and material dispatch of the Fang family. This position is not flashy, but it has great authority-spiritual stones, elixirs, spiritual weapons, medicinal materials, all materials must pass through his hands.
Fang Zhenglin batches "scrapped" spiritual weapons out of the city every three months, but these spiritual weapons are transferred out of the warehouse and the person who handles them is Fang An.
"Is Fang An from Fang Zhenglin?" Fang Zhengyang asked.
"Fang Zhenglin is only the second elder, and Fang An is nominally under his control." Fang Yuan closed the account book, "But Fang An has worked in the Fang family for thirty years and served two family heads. His loyalty is not to Fang Zhenglin, but to the person who gave the money."
A chill flashed in Fang Zhengyang's eyes.
"I sent people to catch him."
"No need to arrest him," Fang Yuan said. "People like Fang An are greedy for money and afraid of death. Put enough pressure on him and he will say anything."
"I'll go." Wang Zixuan walked over from the door and put her long sword on the table. "It's easy for people to gossip when you, the Fang family, judge the Fang family. I'm an outsider, and my attack is not serious. No one can say anything."
Fang Zhengyang glanced at her and nodded: "Miss Wang, you're done."
Wang Zixuan went out with her sword in hand.
Fang Qi took a few people to follow her and disappeared into the night.
Fang Zhengyang and Fangyuan were the only two people left in the main hall again.
Fang Zhengyang was silent for a long time, and then suddenly said: "Fang Yuan, do you think... the Fang family can still be saved?"
Fangyuan looked at him.
This man in his fifties looked more tired than ever. The wrinkles at the corners of his eyes were as deep as knife carvings, and the white hair on his temples was particularly obvious in the candlelight.
"Yes." Fang Yuan said, "As long as you, the head of the family, are here, the Fang family will be saved."
Fang Zhengyang smiled bitterly: "You do know how to talk."
"It's not about talking, it's about telling the truth." Fang Yuan sat down again, picked up the cup of already cold tea, and drank it in one gulp, "The foundation of the Fang family is not on those moths, but on those who are willing to fight for the Fang family. There are not many such people, but there are still."
He looked at Fang Zhengyang.
"Master, you are one of them."
Fang Zhengyang was stunned for a moment, and then laughed.
The laughter was not loud, but it was much more relaxed than before.
"You are better at talking than your father." Fang Zhengyang said, "Your father can't beat a fart with three sticks. Back then I asked him, 'Are you the most talented person in the Fang family?', and he said, 'No.' I asked him, 'Then who do you think he is,' and he said, 'I don't know.' I was so angry.I didn't talk to him for three days. "
The corners of Fangyuan's mouth raised slightly.
"He came to see me the last night before he disappeared. Fang Zhengyang's voice lowered, "He said something to me - 'Brother, if I can't come back, help me take care of Fang Yuan." ’”
Fang Zhengyang looked at Fang Yuan, his eyes slightly red.
